readings.title: 出行时怎么坐公共交通
readings.levelSuggestionZh: A2 建议，日常出行说明

paragraphs.en: Public transportation is a system of scheduled passenger travel that lets strangers share the same route in the same vehicle.
paragraphs.zh: 公共交通是一种按时刻运行的客运系统，让互不相识的人在同一辆车上走同一条路线。

sentences.en: Public transportation is a system of scheduled passenger travel
sentences.zh: 公共交通是一种按时刻运行的客运系统，

sentences.en: that lets strangers share the same route in the same vehicle.
sentences.zh: 让互不相识的人在同一辆车上走同一条路线。

paragraphs.en: In large cities it is often provided by buses and by different rail systems, such as a metro, commuter rail, and trams.
paragraphs.zh: 在大城市里，它常常由公共汽车提供，也可由不同的轨道交通提供，比如地铁、市郊铁路和有轨电车。

sentences.en: In large cities it is often provided by buses
sentences.zh: 在大城市里，它常常由公共汽车提供，

sentences.en: and by different rail systems, such as a metro, commuter rail, and trams.
sentences.zh: 也可由不同的轨道交通提供，比如地铁、市郊铁路和有轨电车。

paragraphs.en: Comfort and reliability vary a lot, but in many large cities it is a practical way to get around, and it usually costs less than a taxi.
paragraphs.zh: 舒适程度和准点程度差别很大，但在许多大城市里，它是一种实用的出行方式，费用通常也比出租车低。

sentences.en: Comfort and reliability vary a lot,
sentences.zh: 舒适程度和准点程度差别很大，

sentences.en: but in many large cities it is a practical way to get around,
sentences.zh: 但在许多大城市里，它是一种实用的出行方式，

sentences.en: and it usually costs less than a taxi.
sentences.zh: 费用通常也比出租车低。

paragraphs.en: These systems often carry large numbers of passengers, so there are fairly often problems with overcrowding, especially at rush hours.
paragraphs.zh: 这些系统常常运送大量乘客，所以相当经常会出现拥挤，尤其是在高峰时段。

sentences.en: These systems often carry large numbers of passengers,
sentences.zh: 这些系统常常运送大量乘客，

sentences.en: so there are fairly often problems with overcrowding, especially at rush hours.
sentences.zh: 所以相当经常会出现拥挤，尤其是在高峰时段。

paragraphs.en: You usually need a ticket. You can buy one at a ticket office, at a machine, or sometimes on your phone. Keep it until you get off, and in some systems tap or show it before you board.
paragraphs.zh: 你通常需要一张票。你可以在售票处、售票机，有时也可以在手机上购买。票要一直留着，直到下车；在有些系统里，上车前还需要拍卡或出示车票。

sentences.en: You usually need a ticket.
sentences.zh: 你通常需要一张票。

sentences.en: You can buy one at a ticket office, at a machine, or sometimes on your phone.
sentences.zh: 你可以在售票处、售票机，有时也可以在手机上购买。

sentences.en: Keep it until you get off, and in some systems tap or show it before you board.
sentences.zh: 票要一直留着，直到下车；在有些系统里，上车前还需要拍卡或出示车票。

paragraphs.en: A driver or an inspector may check your ticket. If you travel without a valid ticket, you may have to pay a fine; this is general information, not a rule for one city.
paragraphs.zh: 司机或查票员可能会检查你的票。如果你没有有效车票就乘车，可能要交罚款；这是一般说明，不是某一座城市的规定。

sentences.en: A driver or an inspector may check your ticket.
sentences.zh: 司机或查票员可能会检查你的票。

sentences.en: If you travel without a valid ticket, you may have to pay a fine;
sentences.zh: 如果你没有有效车票就乘车，可能要交罚款；

sentences.en: this is general information, not a rule for one city.
sentences.zh: 这是一般说明，不是某一座城市的规定。

paragraphs.en: You usually carry your own bags. A large suitcase is hard to manage at rush hour.
paragraphs.zh: 你通常要自己拿行李。在高峰时段，大行李箱很难挪动。

sentences.en: You usually carry your own bags.
sentences.zh: 你通常要自己拿行李。

sentences.en: A large suitcase is hard to manage at rush hour.
sentences.zh: 在高峰时段，大行李箱很难挪动。

paragraphs.en: Don't block the aisle or the doors. Offer your seat if someone needs it more, and look for seats marked as priority seats.
paragraphs.zh: 不要堵住过道或车门。如果有人更需要座位，就把座位让出来，也可以留意标成优先座位的位子。

sentences.en: Don't block the aisle or the doors.
sentences.zh: 不要堵住过道或车门。

sentences.en: Offer your seat if someone needs it more,
sentences.zh: 如果有人更需要座位，就把座位让出来，

sentences.en: and look for seats marked as priority seats.
sentences.zh: 也可以留意标成优先座位的位子。

paragraphs.en: Buses and trains follow a schedule, but there can be a delay. If you miss one bus, the next one may come soon, or you may have to wait longer; this is a learning example, not a timetable for a real city.
paragraphs.zh: 公共汽车和火车会按时刻表运行，但也可能晚点。如果你错过一班车，下一班也许很快就来，也可能要等更久；这是学习情景示例，不是某座真实城市的时刻表。

sentences.en: Buses and trains follow a schedule, but there can be a delay.
sentences.zh: 公共汽车和火车会按时刻表运行，但也可能晚点。

sentences.en: If you miss one bus, the next one may come soon, or you may have to wait longer;
sentences.zh: 如果你错过一班车，下一班也许很快就来，也可能要等更久；

sentences.en: this is a learning example, not a timetable for a real city.
sentences.zh: 这是学习情景示例，不是某座真实城市的时刻表。

readings.title: 电子游戏是什么

paragraphs.en: A video game is an electronic game played on a video screen, normally a television, a computer monitor, or a built-in screen on a handheld machine.
paragraphs.zh: 电子游戏是一种在视频屏幕上玩的游戏，屏幕通常是电视、电脑显示器，或手持设备上的内置屏幕。

sentences.en: A video game is an electronic game played on a video screen,
sentences.zh: 电子游戏是一种在视频屏幕上玩的游戏，

sentences.en: normally a television, a computer monitor, or a built-in screen on a handheld machine.
sentences.zh: 屏幕通常是电视、电脑显示器，或手持设备上的内置屏幕。

paragraphs.en: There are many types, or genres, of video games, such as role-playing games and platform games. People can play them at home on a computer or on a specialized device called a console, and they can also play portable games in other places.
paragraphs.zh: 电子游戏有许多种类，也叫类型，比如角色扮演游戏和平台跳跃游戏。人们可以在家里用电脑玩，也可以用一种专门的设备来玩，这种设备叫做游戏机，还可以在别的地方玩便携游戏。

sentences.en: There are many types, or genres, of video games, such as role-playing games and platform games.
sentences.zh: 电子游戏有许多种类，也叫类型，比如角色扮演游戏和平台跳跃游戏。

sentences.en: People can play them at home on a computer or on a specialized device called a console,
sentences.zh: 人们可以在家里用电脑玩，也可以用一种专门的设备来玩，这种设备叫做游戏机，

sentences.en: and they can also play portable games in other places.
sentences.zh: 还可以在别的地方玩便携游戏。

paragraphs.en: Video games usually come on a disc, or they are downloaded digitally. Some games are played alone, and some are played with other people, often online.
paragraphs.zh: 电子游戏通常存储在光盘上，或者以数字方式下载。有些游戏是独自玩的，有些则是和其他人一起玩，而且常常是在网上。

sentences.en: Video games usually come on a disc, or they are downloaded digitally.
sentences.zh: 电子游戏通常存储在光盘上，或者以数字方式下载。

sentences.en: Some games are played alone,
sentences.zh: 有些游戏是独自玩的，

sentences.en: and some are played with other people, often online.
sentences.zh: 有些则是和其他人一起玩，而且常常是在网上。

paragraphs.en: Mobile devices can also run games, so people can play when they are out. Some games are played on arcade machines in public places. Older games sometimes came in a cartridge, but many games are now downloaded.
paragraphs.zh: 移动设备也可以运行游戏，所以人们出门时也能玩。有些游戏是在公共场所的街机上玩的。较早的游戏有时装在卡带里，但现在许多游戏是下载的。

sentences.en: Mobile devices can also run games, so people can play when they are out.
sentences.zh: 移动设备也可以运行游戏，所以人们出门时也能玩。

sentences.en: Some games are played on arcade machines in public places.
sentences.zh: 有些游戏是在公共场所的街机上玩的。

sentences.en: Older games sometimes came in a cartridge, but many games are now downloaded.
sentences.zh: 较早的游戏有时装在卡带里，但现在许多游戏是下载的。

paragraphs.en: When people play together, they may use voice chat. If the connection is poor, the sound can cut out, or the game can lag; this is a learning example, not a report about a real match.
paragraphs.zh: 人们一起玩时，可能会使用语音聊天。如果网络不好，声音可能会中断，或者游戏会卡顿；这是学习情景示例，不是对某场真实对局的报道。

sentences.en: When people play together, they may use voice chat.
sentences.zh: 人们一起玩时，可能会使用语音聊天。

sentences.en: If the connection is poor, the sound can cut out, or the game can lag;
sentences.zh: 如果网络不好，声音可能会中断，或者游戏会卡顿；

sentences.en: this is a learning example, not a report about a real match.
sentences.zh: 这是学习情景示例，不是对某场真实对局的报道。

paragraphs.en: After a short match, players sometimes start another round, or they use a short spoken phrase to end the game in a friendly way.
paragraphs.zh: 一小局结束后，玩家有时会再开一局，或者用一句简短的口头语友好地结束这局游戏。

sentences.en: After a short match, players sometimes start another round,
sentences.zh: 一小局结束后，玩家有时会再开一局，

sentences.en: or they use a short spoken phrase to end the game in a friendly way.
sentences.zh: 或者用一句简短的口头语友好地结束这局游戏。

paragraphs.en: Competitions of video game players are called electronic sports, also known as e-sports. This article does not review any real game, brand, or current machine.
paragraphs.zh: 电子游戏玩家之间的比赛叫做电子竞技，也称为电竞。本文不评价任何真实游戏、品牌或当前的游戏设备。

sentences.zh: 本文不评价任何真实游戏、品牌或当前的游戏设备。
